title: Medicine Valley
summary: With the Wolf Head Mercenary Company defeated, Little Fairy Doctor's blue eagle Lan carries her and Xiao Yan from Qingshan Town to the hidden Medicine Valley. She gathers herbs from the Rainbow Poison Book while he trains for Dou Shi in the valley's pure energy. Hunting a Rank Two Ice Magical Beast, Xiao Yan saves Ling Er and Qing Ye of the Bloody Battle Mercenary Company. Qing Ye gives him a Rank Two ice Monster Core in thanks, which he needs for the Icy Heart Pill and Path Protecting Pill. Back in the valley, Little Fairy Doctor collapses, and Yao Lao says she has the Woeful Poison Body, which feeds on poison but ends in an agonising death. Xiao Yan promises to cure her and take her travelling. She leaves a note in the night and goes, telling him not to look for her, and he vows to cure her one day.
